concept:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: target concept image for an actual playable real-time 3D browser game, widescreen 16:9.
Primary request: ASHFALL, The Ninth Courtyard. Original mythic space-western frontier outpost after rain, melancholic and beautiful, dense crafted miniature high-isometric 3D environment.
Composition: camera 48 degrees downward looking north across a rectangular 28 by 24 meter courtyard. Readable open wet flagstone central area, intricate tall ochre stone buildings and worn metal gates framing back and left, low broken foreground wall. A central off-center circular bronze water cistern, stacked crates, cloth awnings, bundled pipes, antennae, hanging cables, small tufts of weeds and scattered debris. A narrow alley gate at right leads to a low ridge lookout. Broad puddles reflect amber door lanterns and cool blue skylight. Stone blocks subtly voxel-ish, believable PBR lighting with long soft shadows, ambient occlusion and luminous damp atmosphere.
Subjects: near center foreground a small original helmeted bounty hunter, 1.8m tall, faceted weathered silver armor, narrow diagonal dark visor, split asymmetric crest, dusty oxblood short half-cloak. Beside them a knee-high original scout droid named Tallow: squat rectangular dark teal body, cream armored brow, single thin cyan optical strip, four short articulated crab-like legs, asymmetrical stub antenna, tiny amber belly core. Companion under half player height. No round ball body, no cylindrical astromech.
Mood: cold blue dusk with warm lantern pools, ochre/mud stone, wet reflective ground, rain has stopped, physically believable materials. Rich and detailed, premium indie game screenshot, NOT an illustration, not cartoon outlines. Keep enough exposure to read material detail in shadow.
No text, no UI, no logos, no existing franchise characters, exact costumes or recognizable emblems. Invented designs only.
stone: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tiling PBR base-color texture for Blender mesh UVs. Orthographic flat surface scan of dark warm ochre sandstone, fine worn grain, subtle charcoal grime patches and rain-darkened weathering, small edge chips, mineral flecks. Premium miniature voxel-inspired space-western architectural stone. No stone block seams, no perspective, no lighting gradients, no baked shadows, no highlights, no objects, no text. Even diffuse surface color, square texture tile, all edges seamlessly repeat. A material swatch, not a scene.
metal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tiling PBR base-color texture for Blender armored meshes. Flat orthographic scan of battered charcoal gunmetal alloy with desaturated silver brushed scratches, sparse copper oxidation and fine worn machining lines. Original mythic frontier sci-fi metal. Medium gray values, subtle varied texture. No panels, no objects, no perspective, no baked shadows or lighting highlights, no text, no logos. Seamless square tile, even diffuse lighting, fine scale believable material.
paving: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable PBR basecolor texture for original Blender stone paving meshes in ASHFALL game. Flat orthographic scan of rain-darkened desaturated slate and charcoal limestone, fine chipped crystalline grain, hairline cracks, muted tawny mineral staining, mottled dark sediment. Uniform slab surface without grid joints, no big stones, no perspectives, no objects, no shadows, no lighting gradient, no specular highlights. Premium HD stylized physically believable worn frontier courtyard stone. Mostly medium dark warm gray slate; subtle high frequency roughness and quiet broad patches. Square seamless tile.
city_concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new wide 16:9 isometric 3D game concept for ASHFALL, a premium blocky/HD voxel original space-western city after rain. Reference image is the existing game's art direction, preserve its ochre weathered masonry, forged dark metals, oxblood patched canvas, warm amber lanterns vs cold blue ambient, small helmeted traveler and tiny cream/teal four-legged scout companion. Expand this feel into a connected city five times larger: central wet courtyard with cistern, northern domed bazaar with luminous hologram stall displays and a cantina, western salvage yard with a tracked industrial crawler and dismantled engine, southern landing plaza with a very original asymmetric angular cargo spaceship on three landing legs, eastern fortified watch quarter with sensor towers and a tall blue beacon. Dense layered silhouettes, threshold arches, conduits, ventilation stacks, moisture collectors, repair crews, freight and narrow open routes. Physically believable evening lighting, wet puddles with clear reflections, thin volumetric haze, mournful beautiful lived-in frontier. Design the freighter with offset cockpit pod and three unequal box thrusters, not any recognizable franchise spacecraft. Original clan triple-stroke marks only. No famous characters, no Lucasfilm/Disney logos, no exact costumes or Star Wars ship silhouettes, no text, no HUD. Beautiful production concept rendered in the same premium blocky style as reference, coherent enough to build in a real engine.
ship_panels: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square physically based albedo texture for original science-fiction ship hull meshes in a premium blocky space-western game. Flat orthographic surface only, 2D material atlas texture with large rectangular panels of weathered ivory enamel over dark gunmetal, very subtle worn ochre edges, fine seam lines, small chipped rust pits and delicate rain streaks, broad quiet central areas, a few restrained faded oxblood red repair patches. No text, no symbols, no perspective, no objects, no directional cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or baked highlights, no logos. Tileable at all four edges. Rich physically believable grunge at medium scale, not noisy. This texture will be UV mapped onto hand-made Blender cargo spacecraft and blasters.
